 Ingram Micro India names Farhana Haque as Country Lead & Exec Director, Platform Business
 Ingram Micro India names Farhana Haque as Country Lead & Exec Director, Platform Business
 Haque will report to Flavio Moraes Junior, Vice-President and Chief Country Executive 
 by
 e4m Staff
 Published: 
 Oct 26, 2026 3:08 PM 
 | 
 2 min read 
 Follow Us 
 Show Quick Read
 AI-assisted summary, reviewed by our newsroom
 ▼ 
 Ingram Micro India has appointed Farhana Haque as Country Lead and Executive Director for Platform Business, effective October 21, 2026.
 Haque will report to Flavio Moraes Junior and will be part of the India Executive Leadership Team, focusing on enhancing the company's platform-led business model.
 Her priorities include accelerating the adoption of Ingram Micro's Xvantage platform, expanding into key market segments, and strengthening partner relationships.
 Haque brings extensive experience from Microsoft, Vodafone, and IBM, where she specialized in enterprise transformation, cloud, AI, and strategic partnerships.
 Ingram Micro India has appointed Farhana Haque as Country Lead and Executive Director, Platform Business, effective October 21, 2026.  
 Haque will report to Flavio Moraes Junior, Vice-President and Chief Country Executive, Ingram Micro India, and join the company’s India Executive Leadership Team. 
 --> 
 --> 
 The appointment comes as Ingram Micro continues to strengthen its platform-led business model and customer-centric approach.  
 --> 
 -->
 Flavio Moraes Junior said the company aims to make it easier for partners to discover, purchase, manage and grow their technology businesses through a connected digital ecosystem. He cited Haque’s experience in enterprise transformation, cloud, artificial intelligence (AI) and strategic partnerships as relevant to the company’s platform strategy and SMB growth plans. 
 Haque said she looks forward to leading the Platform Business in India and aligning the company’s cloud, AI and platform capabilities with operational execution. Her priorities include accelerating adoption of Xvantage, Ingram Micro’s platform, expanding across key market segments and strengthening partner relationships. 
 She joins Ingram Micro from Microsoft, where she served as Senior Director.  
 Before Microsoft, she worked at Vodafone, leading its Internet of Things business and driving strategic partnerships and operational expansion across India and the Asia-Pacific region. 
 At IBM, Haque served as General Manager for the Distribution Sector, overseeing initiatives spanning business analytics, optimisation and organisational change. 
 She began her career at Infosys, where she managed SAP projects, alliances, proposals and marketing initiatives.
